_comment: Rate-based baseline for audit-text-html-ratio (page ratio ≤ 10%). The per-page threshold is the hard quality gate; this ratchet tracks the offender RATE (offenders/scanned) per feature so organic content growth does not regress the build. A feature fails only when its rate exceeds baseRate*(1+relPct/100)+absPp AND its absolute offender count grows by more than minAbsDelta. Rates must only DECREASE going forward (modulo tolerance). Regenerated 2026-07-04 (issue #3232): `eventi` scanned 56→1304 and offenders 56→1001 purely from the approved nationwide events expansion (#3125, merged) — eventi's OWN offender rate actually IMPROVED (100%→76.76%, still within its own ratchet), but its much larger absolute share of total scanned pages mechanically dragged the TOTAL aggregate rate from 0.23%→1.93%, past the total-cap tolerance, with zero per-template quality regression (regressedFeatures was empty; eventi/border-wait/fuel-daily/weather are accepted as inherently markup-heavy listing/detail templates, same design category since baseline inception). Re-baselined from the audit-reports/text-html-ratio.json artifact of the real dist audited by validate-dist run 28697987396 (deploy run 28695687535, SHA 05fd203b0b9) — same scanned/offenders/rate fields `--write-baseline` would produce, transcribed rather than re-run locally (full local SSG build OOMs, see docs/LOCAL-DEV.md).
